name: Lofi Station
description: A relaxing lo-fi web app with chill beats and calming vibes for studying, focusing, and unwinding
impact: Built to help people stay focused with a simple, calm music experience.
problem: People often want a focused study/work space without opening a distracting music platform.
approach: I built a lightweight React experience around curated lo-fi playback, clean controls, and a calm interface.
learning: This project helped me practice React state, API usage, styling, and designing around a real user mood.

name: Wanderwise
description: An interactive web app for exploring cities worldwide with detailed data and images.
impact: Created as a school project to make city discovery easier and more visual.
problem: Travel research can feel scattered when city information and visuals are spread across different places.
approach: I focused on a clear search and browsing experience that presents city details in one place.
learning: This strengthened my JavaScript fundamentals, API thinking, and responsive layout practice.
imageAlt: Wanderwise city explorer web app preview

name: To-do Checklist
description: MERN to-do app demonstrating full-stack development and data flow.
impact: Created as a school project to help users organize tasks with persistent account-based data.
problem: A checklist becomes more useful when tasks can be saved, protected, and accessed later.
approach: I built a MERN app with authentication, JWT-based sessions, and database-backed task storage.
learning: This helped me understand full-stack data flow, authentication, backend routes, and MongoDB persistence.
